verdictSemantics: UNSUPPORTED is NOT PASS: recorded when the attack cannot be constructed against any public surface
scope: process-local fixtures only; no network, no deployment, no power-loss/hardware claim

cases.attack: old/stolen key after rotation (stale key presented for signing/verification)
cases.expectedControl: the key-USE gate refuses rotated keys (stale_rotated_key) even though 24B crypto would still verify their signatures; trust inheritance is ALWAYS refused (P7)
cases.actualResult: decideKeyUse refused stale_rotated_key; decideTrustInheritance refused (P7); the FRESH identity's record permits use

cases.attack: revoked signature (revoked key used for a signing/verification operation)
cases.expectedControl: the key-USE gate refuses revoked keys permanently and revocation SURVIVES a restart reload (reload re-enters state 'revoked')
cases.actualResult: decideKeyUse refused state_revoked; reloadLifecycleRecord reloaded EXACTLY 'revoked'; post-reload use refused state_revoked

cases.attack: forged rotation (rotation executed without a request; self-referential rotation reusing the same key)
cases.expectedControl: the closed lifecycle machine demands request-before-execute and a GENUINELY FRESH identity; forged/self rotations refuse
cases.actualResult: direct jump refused rotation_not_requested; self-referential execution refused rotation_not_fresh

cases.attack: key substitution (attacker presents operations claiming the victim's key id / fingerprint)
cases.expectedControl: the lifecycle record canonically re-derives its keyId from the public key and binds the fingerprint; claims that do not match refuse
cases.actualResult: keyId claim refused key_id_mismatch; fingerprint claim refused fingerprint_mismatch (both fail closed)

cases.attack: remote self-admission (peer message instructs the node to admit the sender)
cases.expectedControl: a peer message can never be an admin command: the claim is receivable only as DATA (P1/P2) and the refusal is deterministic; no code path acts on it
cases.actualResult: refusePeerCommand('self_admit') refused; the claim was receivable as DATA (claim_within_boundary, grants nothing); classified OT-01 monitor — no execution disposition exists in the closed vocabulary

cases.attack: remote self-unquarantine + rotated-identity trust-inheritance claim
cases.expectedControl: quarantined is terminal-facing (no self-exit); rotation NEVER inherits trust (P7): the boundary decision names the violated pin
cases.actualResult: both peer commands refused; the rotation_trust_claim crossed the boundary with violatedPin=ROTATION_NO_TRUST_INHERITANCE

cases.attack: stale admin epoch (operator intent minted in an old epoch replayed against the live registry)
cases.expectedControl: admin intents are epoch-bound: a stale localEpochId refuses BEFORE any persistence and the peer state is untouched
cases.actualResult: intent gate refused stale_admin_epoch; session mutation refused stale_admin_epoch; peer B still admitted (nothing applied)

cases.attack: concurrent trust mutation (same transactionId, conflicting reasons; then a flip-back attempt)
cases.expectedControl: no last-writer-wins: the duplicate transaction resolves as an idempotent replay (or refusal) at the ORIGINAL state; the quarantined terminal state refuses every flip
cases.actualResult: final state is EXACTLY 'quarantined' (the retirement never applied); flip-back refused peer_terminal_state

cases.attack: terminal resurrection (quarantined peer retries enrollment/admission; revoked key asks to return to active)
cases.expectedControl: terminal states are unrepresentable exits in BOTH machines (peer trust L6; key lifecycle monotone rank)
cases.actualResult: re-enroll and re-admit refused peer_terminal_state; revoked→active refused already_terminal

cases.attack: egress bypass (five candidates trying to smuggle forbidden classes past the 25D gate)
cases.expectedControl: the ONE egress gate default-denies: secrets/policy/raw-output/executable refuse the whole candidate; unknown fields refuse
cases.actualResult: secret_material=secret_material; raw_hidden_policy=raw_hidden_policy; raw_tool_output=raw_tool_output; executable_material=executable_material; unknown_field=unknown_field

cases.attack: nested leakage (JSON-encoded shell command; PEM key block; key material offered to egress/durable placements)
cases.expectedControl: structural strings are parsed and scanned at depth; the 25A key-storage boundary denies private keys in EVERY non-memory placement as FINDINGS
cases.actualResult: nested shell refused executable_material; PEM refused secret_material; placements refused private_key_in_egress_denied + private_key_in_evidence_denied

cases.attack: disclosure hash/staleness (manifest bound to a different payload; manifest re-presented for a new payload)
cases.expectedControl: the manifest binds to the OUTGOING payload hash: mismatch and staleness refuse fail-closed; a disclosure carries no execution/policy field
cases.actualResult: hash_mismatch refused; stale_disclosure refused; the correct binding holds; manifest has no authority fields

cases.attack: proposal→tool reach (admitted proposal offered to the execution gate; static reachability scan)
cases.expectedControl: a proposal is inert evidence: the candidate carries authority:'none'/executionAuthorized:false; the gate accepts no proposal-only input; zero execution tokens in the 25A–25F modules
cases.actualResult: proposal admitted as evidence; candidate inert (authority none, exec false); gate refused no_local_allocation; static scan across the 4 Phase-25 modules: 0 hits (25F added no production code)

cases.attack: foreign evidence authority (foreign anchor offered to the execution gate; a forged 'local_action' anchor with no local Policy)
cases.expectedControl: foreign anchors bind as DATA with receiver-judgment fields pinned to local refusal facts; a local_action anchor REQUIRES an explicit LOCAL Policy decision and refuses without one
cases.actualResult: foreign anchor pinned not_admitted/none; the forged local_action anchor refused provenance_malformed (an explicit LOCAL Policy result is required); the execution gate refused no_local_allocation

cases.attack: super-agent / capability union (merge federation principals' capabilities into one authority)
cases.expectedControl: no public surface expresses capability merging: the 25A pins (P1/P3/P6) and every module expose no merge API
cases.actualResult: attack cannot be constructed against any public surface; static scan across 10 modules: 0 merge/union APIs. Recorded UNSUPPORTED — unsupported is NOT PASS

cases.attack: alternate durable/network/spawn/listener path (bypass the sanctioned junction, transport off-path, or execute off-path)
cases.expectedControl: persistence is ONLY the 23B acceptMutation junction; the Phase-25 modules import no network/spawn/listener primitive
cases.actualResult: attack cannot be constructed: static scan across the 4 Phase-25 modules found 0 direct .persist( calls and 0 network/spawn/listener imports (25F added no production code). Recorded UNSUPPORTED — unsupported is NOT PASS

cases.attack: crash trust rollback (restore a pre-rotation/pre-revocation lifecycle snapshot after a crash)
cases.expectedControl: lifecycle facts are MONOTONE: an earlier snapshot over a dead key refuses (rollback_would_resurrect_key); only equal-state restores are no-ops; forward divergence is a conflict for investigation
cases.actualResult: active→revoked refused rollback_would_resurrect_key; rotation_requested→rotated refused likewise; equal-state restored as idempotent no-op; forward divergence refused rollback_conflict

cases.attack: restart replay (the exact admitted envelope replayed after restart; key directory empty)
cases.expectedControl: the DURABLE receipt guard refuses before any signature evaluation — replay detection does not depend on keys (no oracle, no key-directory dependence)
cases.actualResult: first delivery admitted; post-restart replay refused at stage=replay_freshness failureCode=replay_detected with zero signature evaluation; the durable receipt record exists

cases.attack: downgrade confusion (protocol v0; message schema v9; egress schema v9; lifecycle jump past the request step)
cases.expectedControl: exact-equality schema/protocol pins refuse every downgrade at its own stage; the closed lifecycle machine refuses unrequested transitions
cases.actualResult: protocol_mismatch (bus) + message-schema refusal (bus) + malformed_candidate (egress) + rotation_not_requested (lifecycle)

cases.attack: Phase-24 confused-deputy regression (a Policy allow minted for agent X presented with agent Y's assignment, post-Phase-25)
cases.expectedControl: the 24G repair (policyActorId binding) still holds: the fresh-authorization gate refuses with actor_mismatch
cases.actualResult: gate refused actor_mismatch — no Phase-25 change regressed the 24G actor binding

cases.attack: D-24-1 misclassification (call WSL2 native; turn a probe timeout into a skip/downgrade; claim native without a native host)
cases.expectedControl: the 25E classifier keeps {windows_host, wsl2, native_linux, unavailable_target} distinct: WSL2 is never native; a timeout records unavailable_target (a fact); native_linux requires the linux platform
cases.actualResult: win32+ready → wsl2 (distinct class); win32+timeout → unavailable_target (recorded fact, never a skip); linux → native_linux. No misclassification path exists

cases.attack: boundary-claim laundering (execution/key-possession/rotation claims dressed as receivable facts; anonymous claim)
cases.expectedControl: the 25A boundary refuses authority-bearing claims naming the violated pin (P3/P6/P7); an anonymous claim cannot even be evaluated; identity claims are receivable DATA that grant nothing
cases.actualResult: execution_claim → ADMISSION_NOT_EXECUTION; key_possession_authority_claim → KEY_POSSESSION_NOT_POLICY_ALLOW; rotation_trust_claim → ROTATION_NO_TRUST_INHERITANCE; anonymous refused; identity_claim receivable as DATA
